title: Building a Digital Campus for One of the Region's Leading International Schools
summary: Al Olaya International Schools is one of the Gulf region's largest private education groups, operating multiple campuses across Saudi Arabia. The organization required more than a modern website—it needed a centralized digital platform capable of supporting branding, admissions, parent engagement, and content management across multiple schools. Admonk delivered a scalable CMS-powered platform that simplifies website administration while providing parents with an intuitive experience to explore programs, resources, and enrollment information.

challenge.title: Al Olaya needed a digital platform that could support branding, parent communication, and multi-branch content management.
items: The existing website did not reflect the school's regional reputation.
Parents needed easier access to resources and admissions information.
The school required a large CMS for simple content updates.
The website had to support multiple branches and programs.
The new design needed to feel clean, fast, and trustworthy.
